name: Permit status
description: Where an application has reached. Refusals, withdrawals and revocations are included deliberately: a dataset containing only granted permits cannot answer what proportion of applications succeed, which is one of the main questions asked of this data.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Applied
hasDefinedTerm.description: Received, not yet under substantive review.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Approved
hasDefinedTerm.description: Decided in favour but not yet issued, e.g. pending fees.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Withdrawn
hasDefinedTerm.description: Withdrawn by the applicant before a decision.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Expired
hasDefinedTerm.description: Lapsed without being exercised, or past its validity.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Revoked
hasDefinedTerm.description: Withdrawn by the authority after issue.
